description: The Pichoux gorge is the limestone slot of the Sorne, vertical walls and a road ledge beside the water, reached from Undervelier in Haute-Sorne. The hour is dry, so the wet-weather springs are not spraying. This replaces Porrentruy Castle, already published. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 12°C, with full cloud cover, humid air, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
